Electricity Quirk.name: Electricity Quirk
Electricity Quirk.description:
⚡ Your body stores electricity and releases it.

🌱 At the start you discharge a crackling burst at everyone within arm's reach, lock a person's muscles with a touch, and run a phone or a dead car battery for a while.
📈 With training and conductive tricks: one-target bolts, building blackouts and takeovers, a restarted heart, a nerve-driven blur, lightning chained through a crowd.
⚠️ Aiming is the hard part: your early bursts hit friend and foe alike.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as overuse scrambles your thinking.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Denki Kaminari (Electrification).

📈 Grants: Speed +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Support Engineering +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Static Burst, Jolt Clasp
🛡️ Resists: electric
Electricity Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the body stores charge and releases it through the skin. A new adult user discharges a burst about arm's length around, drops an adult with a touch shock, runs a phone or car battery some minutes. Untrained discharges spread every way; a bolt hits a chosen target only along a conductor (wire, thrown coin). Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: rubber, insulation and grounding blunt it; water carries it to everyone in it; nearby electronics can fry by accident. Cannot fly, block blows or move metal. Quirk Strain: light: burst, touch shock; moderate: guided bolt, blackout, restarting a heart; heavy: nerve-driven sprint, chained lightning; severe: signature discharge, seizing a building's power. Type: Emitter. Law: shocking a person unlicensed is assault; cutting power to traffic lights or hospitals is endangering the public. Look: static in the hair at rest; in use, yellow-white arcs (or player's color) crawl on the skin, lights flicker, ozone smell.
